d: Small common room to the apartments of the Bey and those of his wife. A sofa in the middle. Elvira sitting on the sofa. Near her Zulma. Around a choir of Eunuchs of the seraglio. Indi Haly, then Mustafà.

Beach of the sea. In some distance a ship broken to a rock and disalberato from the storm, that comes from hand to hand ending. Various People on the ship in action of despair. Here comes the wood of the Corsari; other Corsari come to the ground with Haly and sing to each other the choirs. Indi Isabella and then Taddeo.
Taddeo, Isabella and some Corsari back.
Small hall, like the scene before. Elvira, Zulma and Lindoro.
Magnificent hall. On the right, a sofa for 'l bey. In perspective, a workable railing, on which you can see the Womans of the seraglio. Mustafa sitting. Around, Eunuchs singing the choir; indi Haly.
Taddeo rejecting Haly, who wants to hold him, and sayings.
Small hall as in the first act. Elvira, Zulma, Haly and choir of Eunuchi.
Mustafa, then Taddeo, then Haly with two Moors, who wear a turban, a Turkish dress, a sabre; and the choir of Eunuchs.

Magnificent apartment on the ground floor with a lovely loggia in a façade, which corresponds to the sea. On the right the entrance to various rooms. Isabella before a large portable mirror, which ends to curl up Turkish. Elvira and Zulma, then Mustafà, Taddeo and Lindoro.
Small room, like the scene before act two.
Magnificent apartment on scene five. Taddeo, Lindoro, indi Isabella and a choir of Italian Schiavi.
Lindoro with a choir of Pappataci, and sayings.
A vessel appears, approaching the loggia with Marinari and Schiavi europeo, singing the choir.
Elvira, Zulma, Haly, Mustafà and choir of Eunuchs.
